name: foodbank-server
description: Food bank management server: referrals, sessions, pick lists and stock.

scripts.deploy: npm run -s require-clean-tree && wrangler deploy --env production --var GIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.deploy:test: npm run -s require-clean-tree && wrangler deploy --env "" --var GIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.deploy:uat: npm run -s require-clean-tree && wrangler deploy --env uat --var GIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.build:test: npm run -s require-clean-tree && rm -rf dist/test && wrangler deploy --env "" --dry-run --outdir dist/test && git rev-parse HEAD > dist/test/COMMIT
scripts.build:uat: npm run -s require-clean-tree && rm -rf dist/uat && wrangler deploy --env uat --dry-run --outdir dist/uat && git rev-parse HEAD > dist/uat/COMMIT
scripts.deploy:test:built: npm run -s require-built-commit -- test && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env "" --no-bundle dist/test/worker.js --var GIT_SHA:$(cat dist/test/COMMIT)
scripts.deploy:uat:built: npm run -s require-built-commit -- uat && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env uat --no-bundle dist/uat/worker.js --var GIT_SHA:$(cat dist/uat/COMMIT)
scripts.require-built-commit: f() { npm run -s require-clean-tree && test -f dist/$1/worker.js && test "$(cat dist/$1/COMMIT 2>/dev/null)" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" || { echo "refusing to deploy: dist/$1 was not built from the checked-out commit; run npm run build:$1" >&2; exit 1; }; }; f
scripts.require-clean-tree: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo 'refusing to deploy: uncommitted changes would not be identified by GIT_SHA' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.db:migrate:uat: wrangler d1 migrations apply foodbank-test --remote --env uat
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply foodbank --remote --env production
scripts.check: npm run cf-typegen && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:openapi && npm run test && npm run dry-run
